name: frigate_constitution
description: Heavy 44-gun frigate (USS Constitution type). Three masts, fore + main + mizzen fully square-rigged with a mizzen spanker + gaff, jibs + staysails, complete standing + running rigging, copper-sheathed hull. Two full gun decks (gun-deck long guns + spar-deck carronades) with working port lids, twin bower anchors, working steering. Fully rigged + skinned + animated.

axes.note: Controller orients the root to the game forward. Native negates projection X (handedness swap), so side-named clips (Gun_S, AnchorDrop_S) drive the OPPOSITE game side there — already handled in vessel_anim.cpp; clips are named by GAME side.

materials.note: Procedural wood/paint/metal/copper baked to FOUR per-mesh atlases (merge-by-animation-safety; brig pattern). Each atlas = fr_albedo_<tag>.png (sRGB, ETC1S in GLB) + fr_orm_<tag> (R=occlusion, G=roughness, B=metallic; UASTC) + fr_normal_<tag> (UASTC). Babylon: metallicTexture=orm, useRoughnessFromMetallicTextureGreen, useMetallnessFromMetallicTextureBlue.

atlases.covers: HERO hull planking + weather decks + copper sheathing + gunport stripe
static fittings: bulwarks, head, stern gallery, deck furniture, boats, carvings, iron/brass
skinned spars: masts, yards, gaff, bowsprit, running/standing rope, guns, carriages, rudder, wheel, anchors + cables
the gun-deck + spar-deck port lids (Lid_S / Lid_P morph mesh)

kept_separate.covers: the 17 Sail_* meshes ONLY. MUST stay separate — the client SailBillowPlugin binds it + vertex-displaces it; sharing would billow the ship.
lantern + window + binnacle + skylight glass (8 panes)
kept_separate.note: warm emissiveFactor + KHR_materials_emissive_strength 4; add a Babylon glow layer for lit lanterns/windows

meshes.note: MERGED by animation-safety: 241 objects -> 24 meshes / ~24 draws. Frigate_Plank + Frigate_Hull = static; Frigate_Rigging = skinned morph-free (vertex groups preserved -> mast-fall/trim/guns/wheel/rudder/anchors deform); Frigate_Ports = the lid morph mesh; the 17 sails + Rig_SailSheets + Frigate_Flags + Frigate_Glass kept separate. Loader appends .NNN datablock suffixes; strip them.

clips.name: Trim
clips.axis: yards + gaff local Y yaw (all trim together; the gaff carries the spanker + ensign)

clips.name: AnchorDrop_S
clips.axis: location local Y (= world down); AnchorCable_S pays out via gradient skin (no morph)

clips.name: AnchorDrop_P
clips.axis: location local Y (= world down); AnchorCable_P pays out

clips.name: MastDown_Fore
clips.axis: local Z (topple sideways over the rail; +sign)
clips.note: carries the fore yards+sails+flag; fore standing+running rig follows via foot->mast gradient; jibs drape on their stays

clips.name: MastDown_Mizzen
clips.axis: local Z (+sign; carries the spanker/gaff + ensign)

morph_targets.note: DIRECT morph drive (no clip; the loader/controller prunes morph-weight channels). Each sail has a Furl key (0=set, 0.5=partial/reefed, 1=furled). The gun-port LIDS are morphs too (NOT bone clips like the merchantman): Frigate_Ports has Lid_S + Lid_P (0=closed, 1=open ~82deg), one per broadside (drives both gun-deck + spar-deck lids of that side).

sail_sheet_pairs.note: When furling sail S to value v, set each listed rope morph to v too (sheets/clews gather with the sail).

free_rotation.note: No clip — drive in code. B_Wheel spins about its LOCAL Y (bone points along the fore-aft axle). Flags stream downwind + flutter; the ensign rides B_Gaff so it follows spanker trim then cancels the deviation to stay wind-aligned.

gunnery.note: Per side: open the lid (Lid_{S|P} morph) then run the gun out (Gun_{S|P} clip); recoil reuses the run-out travel. Lids are MORPHS driven directly, guns are a bone clip scrubbed. ALL 3 armament variants are rigged to B_Gun_S/P, so whichever is shown animates.

variants.note: Armament loadout. All 3 gun sets ship IN the GLB as separate skinned meshes (each rigged to B_Gun_S/P); the client shows the active one + hides the other two. Driven by the vessel's `armament` field (server-authoritative; NPCs vary on spawn). Live test override: localStorage.ignis_fr_armament = heavy|medium|light.

mast_damage.schema: three independent zones (fore, main, mizzen), driven from a single collective masts HP.
mast_damage.driver_formula: frac = 1 - hp/maxHp; map onto each zone's window then scrub its MastDown clip. Ease over ~1.5-2.5 s.
mast_damage.hinge_note: Mast topples about local Z (sideways over the rail, alternating sides); pole+tops+yards+sails follow (children); standing+running rigging follows via a foot->mast gradient skin so the rope FEET stay on the hull and stretch.
mast_damage.note: Deck splinter morphs not yet authored (masts hinge clean at the deck) — later combat polish.
